title: indigo_agent_scheduler: uniform, parsable labels for the task list, night plan and history
description:
Make the light labels of AGENT_SCHEDULER_TASK_STATE, AGENT_SCHEDULER_PLAN and AGENT_SCHEDULER_HISTORY easy to read and to parse (TODO "make night plan light labels more parsable" in indigo_agent_scheduler.c). Design agreed with the owner on 2026-11-16.

Today the shapes vary: optional parts (runs, retries, duration) appear only sometimes, hooks put their hook kind where the state should be, the plan mixes two shapes ("20:44–22:36  M31 LRGB #1 (normal 60)" and "M42 — reason") without a date, and the history glues name, marks, result and reason with double spaces and colons.

Format rules (all three lists):
1. Columns joined by " | " (space, pipe, space), always in the same order, always all present.
2. An empty column is "-".
3. Free text (the reason) only in the last column; when a label hits the 511-byte limit only that column is cut (UTF-8 safe).
4. ASCII only. Times UTC (as now). A time range is "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM-HH:MM", dated by its start.
5. Fixed vocabulary in capitals for state/result.
6. Task names must not contain '|': the header parser rejects '@task' names containing '|' with a clear error naming the line (owner decision; a stored task with '|' gets a header error after the upgrade).
7. Night plan and history share the same columns.

Task list (AGENT_SCHEDULER_TASK_STATE): name | state | priority | runs | retries | duration
- state: QUEUED, WAITING, RUNNING, RETRY, REPEAT, DONE, FAILED, EXPIRED, DISABLED, SCRIPT ERROR, or HOOK for a task that serves as a hook.
- priority: "urgent", "<class> <level>" (e.g. "normal 60"), or for hooks "hook startup|shutdown|idle|night start|night end|resume".
- runs: "run <done>/<repeat>" always (e.g. "run 0/1"); retries: "retries left <n>" always; duration: "<h>h<mm> <estimated|measured|set>". Hooks: runs, retries and duration "-".
Example: "M31 LRGB | REPEAT | normal 60 | run 1/2 | retries left 1 | 1h52 estimated", "Park | HOOK | hook shutdown | - | - | -".

Night plan (AGENT_SCHEDULER_PLAN): when | name | run | priority | state | reason
- planned/running runs: when = time range, run = "run <n>/<repeat>" (hooks "-"), priority as above (hooks "hook night start"/"hook night end"), state RUNNING or PLANNED, reason "-".
- tasks not running tonight: when "-", state "NOT TONIGHT", reason = current reason text (constraint, "disabled", "script error", "no time left tonight").
- the no-night notice: "- | - | - | - | NOT TONIGHT | no night at the night limit within a day, the night hooks do not run".
Example: "2026-11-20 20:44-22:36 | M31 LRGB | run 1/2 | normal 60 | PLANNED | -", "- | M42 | run 0/1 | normal 50 | NOT TONIGHT | target below the altitude limit".

History (AGENT_SCHEDULER_HISTORY): when | name | run | kind | result | reason
- run "run <n>"; kind "task", "urgent" or "hook" (from the stored mark, no change to saved history data); result SUCCEEDED, FAILED, PREEMPTED, ABORTED; reason or "-".
Example: "2026-11-20 20:44-21:10 | M31 LRGB | run 1 | task | PREEMPTED | by SN 2026abc".

Unchanged: item names (TASK_%d, PLAN_%d, RUN_%u), light states, order, recomputation, the persisted history fields (labels are rebuilt, so restored history shows the new format).

Work: one column-joining helper (placeholder, last-column cut) used by build_task_state_label, plan_run_label, plan_hook_label, the not-tonight entries in update_plan and history_label; header parser rejects '|' in @task; update INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md ("Watching the scheduler" examples and a short format reference for client authors), indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/doc/SCHEDULER.md and PROPERTIES.md where labels are described; update the label assertions in indigo_test/integration/test_agent_scheduler.c and the task_label helpers/assertions in indigo_test/integration/run_scheduler_simulators.py; add tests that split every label of all three lists and check column count and values (including hooks, not-tonight entries, the no-night notice, reasons with '|' or long text cut only in the last column), and a header unit test for '|' in a task name; bump DRIVER_VERSION; remove the TODO. README.md files are not changed.

outcome.summary: Code conforms to the design: join_label/time_range give six ' | ' columns with '-' placeholders, capitals vocabulary, ASCII separators, UTC 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM-HH:MM' dated by start (midnight crossing correct by construction); hooks, not-tonight rows and the no-night notice match; only the last column can exceed 511 bytes (name <=40, other columns short, 1024-byte buffer, UTF-8-safe cut_label); history labels rebuilt from unchanged persisted entries; add/edit/urgent/config-restore all use indigo_scheduler_parse_header, so the '|' check covers them; version bumped, TODO removed; Python runner updates consistent. Keeping duration source 'default' is correct (task_duration really falls back to SCHEDULER_DEFAULT_DURATION; any of the 3 design words would misreport) and it is documented in the guide. Defects: (1) indigo_docs/PROPERTIES.md:694,705,706 and indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/doc/SCHEDULER.md:351: an unescaped '|' inside backticks in a Markdown table cell splits the cell in GFM, so these rows render with extra cells and the description is cut. SCHEDULER.md already escapes such pipes (line 175 '\|'). Fix: write the separator as ` \| ` in table cells. (2) indigo_docs/INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md:719 says 'the text is ASCII', but the @task parser accepts non-ASCII UTF-8 names and reasons (JS error texts, SEQUENCE_FAILURE.MESSAGE) pass through unchanged, so labels can contain UTF-8. Client authors would get a false guarantee. Fix: say the fixed parts (separators, times, words) are ASCII and that names and reasons are UTF-8 text. Same area: SCHEDULER.md:174 (@task row: 'no control characters') does not mention the new '|' restriction; add it. The comment at indigo_test/integration/test_agent_scheduler.c:727 ('only ASCII before the last column') does not match the code, which checks the whole label. (3) Test effectiveness: the old assertions history_label('Rush (urgent) #1') checked the urgent mark; the replacements at test_agent_scheduler.c:2604, 2616, 2896 only check SUCC

Round 2 on tree 5ea38d4b92a3. The diff since 9bdc2b9ff touches only docs and test assertions, with no change to code behaviour. Verified fixes: the table cells in PROPERTIES.md:694,705,706 and SCHEDULER.md:351 are now escaped; the guide's ASCII sentence is accurate; the @task rows in the guide (178) and SCHEDULER.md (174) mention '|'; the check_columns comment matches the code; history asserts '| Rush | run 1 | urgent | SUCCEEDED | -' (twice) and '| Flash | run 1 | urgent | SUCCEEDED | -'; wait_plan_first checks '| RUNNING |' and '| PLANNED |'. New defect: indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/doc/SCHEDULER.md:640 and :680 are a list item and a paragraph, not table rows, yet the separator was changed to ' \| ' there too. Outside a table a backslash in a code span is literal in CommonMark/GFM, so these two lines now render the separator as '\|', which is wrong and contradicts the example on the same line 640 (' | ' unescaped). Fix: revert these two lines to an unescaped ' | ' and keep '\|' only in the table rows.

Final round on tree 98ba5d309479. The diff since the round-2 commit 93d0fa2aa changes only SCHEDULER.md:640 and :680, back to a plain ' | ' outside tables. The table rows SCHEDULER.md:351 and PROPERTIES.md:694,705,706 keep '\|', and none of SCHEDULER.md, PROPERTIES.md or INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md has an escaped pipe outside a table row. All earlier findings are resolved; code is unchanged since round 1, where it conformed to the design. Checks recorded on this tree: whitespace, unit, integration 104/0. Notes: the urgent_tasks_are_counted flake is unrelated (pre-existing race: TOTAL is read without waiting); history persisted before the upgrade with a '|' in a task name renders with extra columns, accepted by the owner decision.
